customManagers.description: Keep the ruff/mypy pins in the CI workflow in sync with pyproject.toml [dependency-groups].

packageRules.description: Group the runtime dependency ranges (pyproject.toml) with the pinned versions in docker/constraints.txt so the image never builds against a stale pin.
Update the ruff/mypy dev-tool pins in pyproject.toml and .github/workflows/deploy-test.yml in a single PR.
